title: Tool error not recovered: patch_file on adapters/mod.rs
description: patch_file returned 'old_string not found' when attempting to add the WithThinking variant to src/moeb/src/adapters/mod.rs. The file had been read via read_file immediately before the patch_file call. Likely cause: CRLF vs LF line ending mismatch between what read_file returns and what patch_file expects. The error was immediately recovered by calling write_file with the complete file content.
proposed_resolution: Investigate why patch_file fails with 'old_string not found' on Windows CRLF files even after a read_file call in the same session. Normalize line endings consistently in both read_file and patch_file, or document that write_file is preferred for Windows-hosted repositories.
